newsitem.title: USA: Sprint gets 5-year contract in Connecticut.
newsitem.headline: Sprint gets 5-year contract in Connecticut.

text.p: Sprint Corp said Thursday it has been awarded a contract by the Connecticut Department of Utility Control to continue providing Telecommunications Relay Services for Connecticut's deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind and speech disabled consumers.
The five-year contract, which begins immediately, is valued at up to $5 million.
Sprint provides telecommunications relay services for 18 states and for the federal government. Later this summer, Sprint will add the states of New York and California to its roster.
